description: Sourdough & Co. (World of Sourdough Franchising, LLC) is a quick-service sandwich restaurant franchise offering handcrafted sandwiches, soups, salads, pasta, beverages and catering from eat-in/carry-out retail locations. FDD Item 19 reports average 2024 sales of $719,491 across 64 locations open all year (range $297,320-$1,117,988); Item 20 shows 80 outlets systemwide as of 2024-12-31 with zero terminations in 2022-2024. Initial investment $285,800-$568,725; 5% royalty; 2-mile protected (non-exclusive) territory.
category: Food & Beverage - Sandwich / Quick Service Restaurant
territoryDescription: 2-mile radius of the Specific Location (MapQuest). Non-exclusive: franchisor may place Non-Traditional Sites (malls, airports, campuses, military, inside retail) inside the radius and competes via other channels. (FDD Item 12, pp37-38) FDD Item 20 Table 1 (p74) lists 80 outlets systemwide as of 2024-12-31; 12 are mapped as pins on this page.

item20_reconciliation: FDD Item 20 (p69, as of 2024-12-31): 80 total outlets (78 franchised + 2 affiliate-owned per Table 1; Table 3 state detail sums to 80 franchised, a 2-unit internal table discrepancy noted and cited). Trade press Sep 2026: 82 operating locations. Net +2 since FDD date.

t_risk_score.citation: method: weighted composite 0-100 (higher=riskier): litigation(75)x0.20 + closure_history(10)x0.15 + fee_burden(45)x0.15 + item19_evidence(55)x0.20 + system_maturity(50)x0.15 + territory_protection(60)x0.10 + growth_trend(30)x0.05 = 48.75 -> 49

t_closure_rate_3yr.citation: method: terminations + ceased operations / average outlets 2022-2024 = 0/(5+63+80)/3 = 0% (FDD Item 20, p70)

t_fee_burden_pct.citation: method: 5% royalty + 1% local ad + ~0.5% tech ($285/mo on $60k/mo avg) = ~6.5-7% of revenue; $49,500 initial on $719,491 avg = 6.9% of one year sales

t_payback_years.citation: method: midpoint investment $427,263 / assumed 12% EBITDA margin on $719,491 avg sales = $86,339/yr -> 4.9-5.5 yrs; illustrative only, margin not disclosed in FDD

t_unit_efficiency.citation: method: avg unit sales $719,491 / midpoint investment $427,263 = 1.68x sales-to-investment; monthly sales $59,958 covers ~$3,000 royalty+ad+tech with room

t_system_growth_rate.citation: method: net outlet growth 2024: +17 on 63 base = 27% (FDD Item 20, p69)

t_saturation_risk.citation: method: 71 of 80 outlets in CA (89%); 2-mile protected radius + non-traditional carve-outs; 36 signed-not-opened concentrated in CA

t_franchisee_support_score.citation: method: 98-230h initial training + HQ support, but no financing, 2-person training coverage, refresher at franchisee cost

t_item19_confidence.citation: method: 64/80 outlets (80%) included; range wide ($297k-$1.118M); unaudited/unverified; affiliate home-market skew disclosed
